sessions.title: Understand Your Emotions
sessions.purpose: Today's session will help you understand what's behind your emotions and create some distance from the breakup.

steps.title: Check in with yourself
steps.instruction: How are you feeling right now?
steps.why: Start by noticing what you are feeling instead of pushing it away.

steps.title: Identify the trigger
steps.instruction: What situation, thought, or memory may have triggered this feeling?
steps.why: Knowing what triggered you can make the emotion easier to understand and manage.

steps.title: Put it into words
steps.instruction: Write about what is going through your mind right now.
steps.why: Putting your thoughts into words can create some distance from them.

steps.title: Remember what you know
steps.instruction: Take a moment to revisit the relationship red flags you recorded.
steps.why: When emotions are strong, remembering the full picture can help you stay grounded.

steps.title: Notice one thing you handled well
steps.instruction: Record one small win from today.
steps.why: Progress is built by noticing the moments when you choose yourself.

completion.title: You showed up for yourself today. ❤️
completion.message: You took time to understand what you are feeling instead of letting the feeling control you.

sessions.title: Handle the Urge
sessions.purpose: This session gives you a simple path to move through the urge to contact your ex without acting on it.

steps.title: Check in with yourself
steps.instruction: How strong is the urge and what are you feeling right now?
steps.why: Naming the emotion and intensity gives you a starting point.

steps.title: Find the trigger
steps.instruction: What caused you to want to reach out?
steps.why: An urge usually has a trigger. Identifying it helps you separate the trigger from the action.

steps.title: Come back to the present
steps.instruction: Use 5-4-3-2-1 grounding to reconnect with what is happening right now.
steps.why: Grounding can interrupt the spiral and bring your attention back to the present moment.

steps.title: Remember your progress
steps.instruction: Read through your recorded wins.
steps.why: Reminding yourself of times you chose yourself reinforces the progress you have already made.

steps.title: Fight the urge
steps.instruction: Use Fight the Urge before making any decision about contacting your ex.
steps.why: Give yourself space between the urge and the action.

completion.title: You rode out the urge. 🔥
completion.message: You gave yourself space instead of letting a difficult moment decide what happens next.

sessions.title: Create Emotional Space
sessions.purpose: Today's session helps you get anxious thoughts out of your head and create a little room to breathe.

steps.title: Notice what is weighing on you
steps.instruction: Check in with your current mood.
steps.why: Start by acknowledging your emotional state without judging it.

steps.title: Set the worry down
steps.instruction: Put the worry or anxious thought into your Worry Box.
steps.why: You do not have to solve every thought the moment it appears.

steps.title: Slow things down
steps.instruction: Complete a breathing exercise.
steps.why: Give yourself a deliberate pause before returning to the rest of your day.

steps.title: Say what you wish you could say
steps.instruction: Write an unsent letter to your ex.
steps.why: Expressing the words privately can be different from acting on them.

steps.title: Shift your attention
steps.instruction: Add something you're grateful for.
steps.why: End the session by deliberately noticing something positive that still exists in your life.

completion.title: You made some space today. 🌱
completion.message: You gave your thoughts somewhere to go without giving them control over your actions.

sessions.title: Stop Romanticizing the Past
sessions.purpose: When you miss someone, it is easy to remember only the best moments. This session helps you look at the relationship as a whole.

steps.title: Notice how you are feeling
steps.instruction: Check in with your mood before reflecting.
steps.why: Strong emotions can influence which memories come to mind first.

steps.title: Look at the full picture
steps.instruction: Read the red flags you recorded during the relationship.
steps.why: Revisiting the difficult parts can balance an idealized version of the past.

steps.title: Write what you are remembering
steps.instruction: Journal about what you miss and what you do not miss.
steps.why: Separating the good memories from the reality of the relationship can bring clarity.

steps.title: Remember what you survived
steps.instruction: Read your recorded wins.
steps.why: Your own progress is part of the story too.

steps.title: Choose your next step
steps.instruction: Read today's Daily Motivation.
steps.why: Finish by bringing your attention back to healing rather than the past.

completion.title: You looked at the whole picture. ❤️
completion.message: Missing someone does not erase what happened or the reasons you chose to heal.

sessions.title: Understand Your Relationship Patterns
sessions.purpose: Today's session helps you reflect on recurring situations and behaviors so you can learn from the relationship.

steps.title: Start with how you feel
steps.instruction: Check in with yourself.
steps.why: Reflection works best when you first recognize your current emotional state.

steps.title: Spot what set things off
steps.instruction: Review or log situations that repeatedly triggered difficult emotions.
steps.why: Patterns become easier to see when you identify the situations that kept repeating.

steps.title: Look at the unhealthy patterns
steps.instruction: Review the red flags you recorded.
steps.why: Seeing repeated patterns can help you recognize what you do not want to repeat.

steps.title: Reflect on your part
steps.instruction: Journal about what you learned about yourself from the relationship.
steps.why: The goal is not blame. It is understanding what you can carry forward and what you can change.

steps.title: Build something different
steps.instruction: Work on a personal goal or routine that supports the person you want to become.
steps.why: Growth becomes real when reflection turns into a small change in your life.

completion.title: You learned something about yourself. 🧠
completion.message: Understanding a pattern gives you the chance to make a different choice next time.

sessions.title: Rebuild Your Confidence
sessions.purpose: A breakup can make you question yourself. This session helps you reconnect with your strengths and take one step forward.

steps.title: Check in
steps.instruction: How are you feeling about yourself today?
steps.why: Notice where your confidence is right now without judging yourself.

steps.title: Remember your wins
steps.instruction: Read the personal wins you have already recorded.
steps.why: Your breakup does not erase the things you have accomplished or the times you have chosen yourself.

steps.title: Speak to yourself differently
steps.instruction: Complete an affirmation that feels meaningful today.
steps.why: Practice replacing harsh self-talk with a more supportive message.

steps.title: Choose one goal
steps.instruction: Work on a personal goal or routine.
steps.why: Confidence grows when you take action and keep promises to yourself.

steps.title: Finish with encouragement
steps.instruction: Read today's Daily Motivation.
steps.why: End by reinforcing the decision to keep moving forward.

completion.title: You chose yourself today. 💪
completion.message: Confidence is rebuilt one small action at a time.

sessions.title: Reconnect With Yourself
sessions.purpose: This session helps you shift some attention away from the relationship and back toward your own life.

steps.title: Check in with yourself
steps.instruction: How are you feeling today?
steps.why: Start by making space for your own experience.

steps.title: Remember who you are
steps.instruction: Journal about the interests, values, and parts of yourself you want to reconnect with.
steps.why: A relationship can become a big part of life without being your entire identity.

steps.title: Choose a supportive message
steps.instruction: Complete an affirmation that reflects the person you are becoming.
steps.why: Give yourself a reminder that your identity continues beyond the breakup.

steps.title: Build your routine
steps.instruction: Work on a goal or routine that is just for you.
steps.why: Creating structure helps turn self-reflection into forward movement.

steps.title: Step outside
steps.instruction: Take an Outdoor Walk.
steps.why: Changing your environment can give you a simple reset and a break from repetitive thoughts.

completion.title: You made space for yourself. 🌱
completion.message: Your life is still yours to build, one choice at a time.

sessions.title: Let It Out Without Sending It
sessions.purpose: Get the thoughts out without reopening the conversation. This session gives your emotions a private place to land.

steps.title: Notice what is coming up
steps.instruction: Check in with your mood.
steps.why: Start by acknowledging the emotion before trying to release it.

steps.title: Write what you want to say
steps.instruction: Write an unsent letter to your ex.
steps.why: You can express everything without turning the emotion into contact.

steps.title: Set the worry down
steps.instruction: Put any remaining anxious thought into the Worry Box.
steps.why: Not every thought needs an immediate answer.

steps.title: Breathe before moving on
steps.instruction: Complete a breathing exercise.
steps.why: Give yourself a calm transition after an emotionally intense reflection.

steps.title: End with something positive
steps.instruction: Add one thing you're grateful for.
steps.why: Close the session by deliberately noticing something outside the breakup.

completion.title: You released it without reaching out. ❤️
completion.message: You found a way to express yourself while protecting your healing.

sessions.title: When You Miss Them
sessions.purpose: Missing someone is not the same as needing them back. This session helps you understand the feeling before acting on it.

steps.title: Name the feeling
steps.instruction: Check in with yourself.
steps.why: Start by separating the feeling of missing them from the decision to contact them.

steps.title: Write what you miss
steps.instruction: Journal about what you are actually missing.
steps.why: You may be missing a person, a feeling, a routine, or a version of your life.

steps.title: Remember what was real
steps.instruction: Read the red flags you recorded.
steps.why: Missing the good parts should not make you forget the difficult parts.

steps.title: Remember yourself
steps.instruction: Read your recorded wins.
steps.why: Reconnect with the progress you have made without contacting them.

steps.title: Protect the progress
steps.instruction: Use Fight the Urge.
steps.why: Give yourself a chance to let the feeling pass before making a decision.

completion.title: You let the feeling pass without acting on it. 🌱
completion.message: You can miss someone and still choose yourself.

sessions.title: Reset After a Difficult Day
sessions.purpose: When today has been hard, use this short reset to calm your mind and give yourself a fresh start.

steps.title: Check in
steps.instruction: Record how you are feeling after today.
steps.why: Acknowledging a difficult day is better than pretending it did not affect you.

steps.title: Put the worries down
steps.instruction: Add the thoughts you keep replaying to the Worry Box.
steps.why: Give repetitive thoughts somewhere to go instead of carrying them into the rest of your evening.

steps.title: Slow your breathing
steps.instruction: Complete a breathing exercise.
steps.why: Create a deliberate pause before moving on from the day.

steps.title: Listen and reflect
steps.instruction: Play a Healing Audio session.
steps.why: Give yourself a quieter space to process what happened today.

steps.title: Take one positive thought with you
steps.instruction: Read today's Daily Motivation.
steps.why: Finish with a reminder that one difficult day does not define your journey.

completion.title: Today is allowed to be over. 🌙
completion.message: You made time to reset instead of carrying the whole day into tomorrow.

sessions.title: Build a Better Routine
sessions.purpose: Use today’s session to turn healing into small daily actions that give your life structure again.

steps.title: Check in
steps.instruction: How has your current routine been affecting your mood?
steps.why: Understanding where you are helps you choose a realistic next step.

steps.title: Choose what matters today
steps.instruction: Review or complete one of your Daily Tasks.
steps.why: Small completed actions can help restore a sense of control.

steps.title: Set a personal goal
steps.instruction: Work on a goal or routine that supports your recovery.
steps.why: A future-focused goal gives your energy somewhere constructive to go.

steps.title: Change your environment
steps.instruction: Take an Outdoor Walk.
steps.why: Step away from the same environment and give your mind a physical reset.

steps.title: Recognize the effort
steps.instruction: Record a win from what you accomplished today.
steps.why: Notice the evidence that you are capable of moving forward.

completion.title: You built a little momentum today. 🚶
completion.message: A better life is built through small actions repeated over time.

sessions.title: Focus on Your Future
sessions.purpose: Shift your attention from what ended toward the life you still have the power to build.

steps.title: Write what is on your mind
steps.instruction: Journal about where you are in your healing journey right now.
steps.why: Acknowledge where you are before thinking about where you are going.

steps.title: Choose what you are building
steps.instruction: Work on a personal goal or routine for your future.
steps.why: Your attention becomes more powerful when it is connected to something you want to create.

steps.title: Look at your journey
steps.instruction: Review your Healing Journey and the progress you have made.
steps.why: Looking back at your progress can make the distance you have traveled easier to see.

steps.title: Reinforce who you are becoming
steps.instruction: Complete an affirmation that supports your next chapter.
steps.why: Give yourself a clear internal reminder of the direction you are choosing.

steps.title: Finish with motivation
steps.instruction: Read today's Daily Motivation.
steps.why: End by turning your attention toward the next step rather than the last chapter.

completion.title: Your future is still yours. 🌱
completion.message: You do not have to know every step yet. You only need to keep moving forward.

sessions.title: Remember Why You Are Healing
sessions.purpose: Reconnect with the reasons you chose No Contact and remind yourself why protecting your progress matters.

steps.title: Check in
steps.instruction: How are you feeling about your No Contact journey today?
steps.why: Recognize your current emotional state before revisiting your reasons.

steps.title: Remember what hurt
steps.instruction: Read the red flags you recorded.
steps.why: Your reasons for healing deserve to remain visible when nostalgia appears.

steps.title: Remember what you have overcome
steps.instruction: Read your recorded wins.
steps.why: Every time you chose yourself, you created evidence that you can keep going.

steps.title: Say what you still need to say
steps.instruction: Write an unsent letter if there are words you still need to express.
steps.why: You can acknowledge unfinished feelings without reopening contact.

steps.title: Reconnect with your commitment
steps.instruction: Review your No Contact Streak.
steps.why: Seeing your ongoing progress can reinforce why you do not want one difficult moment to erase it.

completion.title: Your healing still matters. 🔥
completion.message: You remembered why you started and gave yourself another reason to keep going.

sessions.title: Choose Yourself Today
sessions.purpose: A balanced session to reconnect with your emotions, your needs, and one positive choice you can make for yourself today.

steps.title: Check in with yourself
steps.instruction: How are you feeling right now?
steps.why: Choosing yourself starts with paying attention to what you actually need.

steps.title: Clear some mental space
steps.instruction: Put one worry or anxious thought into the Worry Box.
steps.why: Make room for something more constructive by setting one worry aside.

steps.title: Speak to yourself with care
steps.instruction: Complete an affirmation.
steps.why: Give yourself the same patience you would offer someone you care about.

steps.title: Notice something good
steps.instruction: Add something you're grateful for today.
steps.why: Healing is not only about what you are leaving behind. It is also about noticing what remains.

steps.title: Take one step forward
steps.instruction: Record one win from today.
steps.why: End by recognizing one concrete way you chose yourself.

completion.title: You chose yourself today. ❤️
completion.message: That is what healing looks like: one small choice at a time.
